numeric_literal_policy: No int/float literals are permitted anywhere under claims[*].values. Evidence numbers must be resolved from selectors/transforms.

claims.claim_boundary: Controlled pseudo-chronological CICIDS2017 scenario; counts are construction identities, not independent replicates.
Fit on frozen training partition only; no development/pre/post fitting.

C and D share the adaptive neural/control-plane trajectory; detector input is delayed and checkpoint-pure.
Drift and periodic arms use the matched frozen symbolic operator, validation gate, lifecycle policy, and opportunity budget.

claims.source_section: Trigger timing is a major interpretation constraint
claims.claim_boundary: Boundary is scoring-only; publication timing constrains post-boundary repair language.
Maintenance rows/opportunities are longitudinal diagnostics, not independent replicates.
Recovery is secondary and window-defined; censored seeds remain censored.
Lambda=1 removes symbolic predictive authority and is a causal-isolation negative control.

claims.source_section: Main D-drift versus C post-reference result
claims.claim_boundary: Exploratory post-primary decomposition; does not replace E1/E2/E3.
Row counts are descriptive longitudinal observations, not independent replicates.

claims.source_section: D-periodic shows the same mechanism family
claims.claim_boundary: Periodic mechanism context is descriptive matched-comparator evidence, not a new confirmatory endpoint.

claims.claim_text_template: robustness conditionwise d drift minus c
claims.source_section: Main robustness question: D-drift versus frozen-symbolic C
claims.claim_boundary: Prespecified same-scenario robustness; no new confirmatory p-value family.

claims.source_section: Lambda=1 is the decisive causal negative control
claims.claim_boundary: Lambda=1 is neural-only; paired-effect direction in the aggregate is lambda=1 minus primary lambda=.50.
Sensitivity conditions cannot replace the primary configuration.
Mixed trigger contrasts do not establish categorical superiority of drift-triggered maintenance.
Robustness evidence does not establish a prediction-and-explanation win-win.

claims.source_section: Trigger timing still rejects a simple boundary-detect-then-repair story
claims.claim_boundary: Publication-clock audit is descriptive/post-export and creates no new hypothesis test.
Evidence is conditional on one controlled benign-source-regime-dominant CICIDS2017 scenario; no cross-dataset or deployment-population generalization.
